Question: What is the average number of pairs of consecutive integers in a randomly selected subset of \(5\) distinct integers chosen from the set \(\{1, 2, 3, \ldots, 30\}?\) (For example the set \(\{1, 17, 18, 19, 30\}\) has \(2\) pairs of consecutive integers.)
